title: [29.X]-Sales/Purchase Price List activation allows Duplicate Lines when the Price List is Inactive.
summary: Activating a sales or purchase price list no longer allows duplicate lines that were added while the price list was inactive. The fix is a one-line change in Price List Management, with a new unit test.
key_points: Activating a price list no longer lets duplicate lines through
Affects lines added while the price list was inactive
Applies to both sales and purchase price lists
One-line fix in the Price List Management codeunit
Unit test added in Price List Header UT
